text: bhāvethāti . [266] 20 devame bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti katame deva dunnikkhittañca padabyañjanaṃ attho ca dunnīto dunnikkhittassa bhikkhave padabyañjanassa atthopi dunnayo hoti ime kho bhikkhave deva dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti . devame bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattanti katame deva sunikkhittañca padabyañjanaṃ attho ca sunīto sunikkhittassa bhikkhave padabyañjanassa atthopi sunayo hoti ime kho bhikkhave deva dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantīti . adhikaraṇavaggo dutiyo . [267] 21 devame bhikkhave bālā katame deva yo ca accayaṃ accayato na passati yo ca accayaṃ desentassa yathādhammaṃ na paṭiggaṇhāti ime kho bhikkhave deva bālā . devame bhikkhave paṇḍitā katame deva yo ca accayaṃ accayato passati yo ca accayaṃ desentassa yathādhammaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti ime kho bhikkhave deva paṇḍitāti . [268] 22 devame bhikkhave tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti katame deva duṭṭho vā dosantaro saddho vā duggahitena ime kho bhikkhave deva tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhantīti . [269] 23 devame bhikkhave tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti katame deva yo ca abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatena bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpeti yo ca bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatena abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpeti ime kho bhikkhave deva tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti . devame bhikkhave tathāgataṃ nābbhācikkhanti katame deva yo ca abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatena abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpeti yo ca bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatena bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpeti ime kho bhikkhave deva tathāgataṃ nābbhācikkhantīti . [270] 24 devame bhikkhave tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti katame deva yo ca neyyatthaṃ suttantaṃ nītattho suttantoti dīpeti yo ca nītatthaṃ suttantaṃ neyyattho suttantoti dīpeti ime kho bhikkhave deva tathāgataṃ abbhācikkhanti . devame bhikkhave tathāgataṃ nābbhācikkhanti katame deva yo ca neyyatthaṃ suttantaṃ neyyattho suttantoti dīpeti yo ca nītatthaṃ suttantaṃ nītattho suttantoti dīpeti ime kho bhikkhave deva tathāgataṃ nābbhācikkhantīti . [271] 25 paṭicchannakammantassa bhikkhave dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññatarā gati pāṭikaṅkhā nirayo vā tiracchānayoni vā 1 . appaṭicchannakammantassa bhikkhave dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññatarā gati pāṭikaṅkhā devā vā manussā vāti . [272] 26 micchādiṭṭhikassa bhikkhave dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññatarā gati pāṭikaṅkhā nirayo vā tiracchānayoni vā 1 . sammādiṭṭhikassa bhikkhave davinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññatarā gati pāṭikaṅkhā devā vā manussā vāti . [273] 27 dussīlassa bhikkhave deva paṭiggahā 2 nirayo vā tiracchānayoni vā 1 . sīlavato bhikkhave deva paṭiggahā 3 devā vā manussā vāti . [274] 28 dvāhaṃ bhikkhave atthavase sampassamāno
